question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
full_reference: Full-time employees get 15 vacation days per year.

question: How many paid sick days does each employee get per year?
full_reference: Every employee gets 10 paid sick days per year.

question: Within how many days must I submit an expense claim?
full_reference: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase.

question: Can I carry unused vacation days over into next year?
reference: Yes, up to 5 unused vacation days can be carried over into the next calendar year. Any days above 5 expire on December 31.

question: In total, how many paid vacation and sick days does a full-time employee get per year?
reference: A full-time employee gets 15 vacation days and 10 paid sick days per year, which is 25 paid days off in total.

question: How much money can I get for setting up my home office, and how much for learning each year?
reference: You get a one-time home office stipend of $500 and a learning budget of $1,000 per year.

question: My baby was just born. How long can I stay at home and still get my full salary?
reference: New parents get 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

question: I'm ill for two days. Will HR want a doctor's note?
reference: No. A doctor's note is only required when you are out sick for more than 3 consecutive days.

question: On which weekdays am I expected to be physically in the office?
reference: Most teams are in the office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

question: Does Northwind Corp offer stock options to employees?
reference: I don't know. The HR documents do not mention stock options.
